record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.context_brief: dense open CDH subspaces of Polish 1/omega-CDH spaces
record.original_question: If a Polish space is 1/omega-CDH, meaning that it has exactly countably many equivalence classes of countable dense subsets under self-homeomorphisms, must it contain a dense open countable dense homogeneous subspace?

evidence.quote: Call a topological space X 1 κ-CDH if there are exactly κ-many types of countable dense subsets of X, i.e. κ-many equivalence classes of the family of all countable dense sets of X modulo an equivalence relation
Problem 23. Does every Polish 1 ω -CDH space contain a dense open CDH subspace?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A topological space $X$ is countable dense homogeneous (CDH) if for any two countable dense subsets $D_1, D_2 \subseteq X$ there exists a homeomorphism $h : X \to X$ with $h(D_1) = D_2$. For a cardinal $\kappa$, declare two countable dense subsets of $X$ equivalent if some self-homeomorphism of $X$ maps one onto the other; call $X$ $\tfrac{1}{\kappa}$-CDH if there are exactly $\kappa$ equivalence classes of countable dense subsets of $X$ under this relation. A Polish space is a separable, completely metrizable topological space.

Question: Does every Polish $\tfrac{1}{\omega}$-CDH space $X$ contain a nonempty dense open subspace $U \subseteq X$ such that $U$ (with the subspace topology) is countable dense homogeneous?
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution was found. Recent works on countable dense homogeneity (e.g., on zero-dimensional metrizable CDH spaces and CDH topological groups, 2024–2025) continue to investigate structural questions about Polish CDH spaces but do not report a solution to this specific question about Polish 1/ω-CDH spaces containing a dense open CDH subspace.

status_evidence.snippet: Recent investigations of CDH properties in Polish and zero-dimensional settings, with no mention of resolving the 1/ω-CDH dense-open-subspace problem.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research on Polish CDH spaces does not report a resolution of this problem.

status_evidence.title: Countable dense homogeneity and topological groups
status_evidence.snippet: Continues study of CDH spaces; no resolution of the 1/ω-CDH problem cited.
status_evidence.claim: The problem appears to remain open as of recent literature.
